note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #12, Q3 2025 Family Violence; exports mexico_2025_q3safety_violence.csv) keeps INEGI columns bp4_3_1..bp4_3_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925.csv (import delimited case(lower)), sets code 9 to missing (the 'Q3 Section IV: domestic/family violence' recode block, applies to 2024 Q3 and 2025 Q3) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 2025 Q3 data dictionary labels each BP4_3_k column 'Situacion vivida: <situation k>' and 6/6 labels agree in content with printed situation k of question 4.3; catalogos bp4_3_1..6 give 1=Si, 2=No, 9=No sabe / no responde, identical to the printed codes. Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered 2025 Q3 questionnaire wording (confirmed on a 110-dpi render of pp.5-6), not the dictionary labels. The 2025 labels differ from the 2025 print in one place: BP4_3_3's label omits 'pellizcado,' (print: 'por ejemplo, pellizcado, jalado el cabello, ...'), same defect as 2024; the print is shipped. (The 2024 label's 'obligarte' is corrected to 'obligarle' in 2025, and BP4_3_2's label reads 'correrle' as printed.) All 10 distinct Spanish strings shipped (CP3, CP4, 4.3 stem, 6 situations; plus options Si/No) are exact substrings of the pdftotext -raw output after whitespace normalisation. Step 3b / 2025 Q3 vs 2024 Q3 print (pdftotext of both, diffed, not assumed): CP3, CP4 and situations 1 and 3-6 identical; two wording changes, both shipped as printed: (a) 4.3 stem reference period 'de octubre de 2024 a la fecha' (2024 Q3: 'de octubre de 2023'); (b) situation 2 now ends 'amenazado con correrle?' (2024 Q3: 'correrlo(a)?'). Interviewer-direction changes only otherwise (2024's 'AL TERMINAR DE LEER LOS CODIGOS DE LAS 6 SITUACIONES, REALIZA LAS PREGUNTAS 4.4 Y 4.5 ...' replaced by 'APLIQUE 4.4 Y 4.5 PARA CADA CODIGO 1 REGISTRADO EN 4.3'), stripped in both years. Structure (batch_684 convention): one section_id; instructions = CP3 (Section IV introduction, p.5) then CP4 (p.6), joined with a space -- questions 4.1 (household screener, Tarjeta D; codes 2/9 'PASE A 4.3') and 4.2 (were victims under 18) sit between them and are not in this table; section_prompt = the 4.3 stem; item_text = the six situations. 4.3 is asked of every respondent, so no routing shapes these items. Kept as printed: leading question marks, parenthetical examples. Stripped: situation numbers 1.-6., question number 4.3, entry boxes, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'D' Y REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; the instruction to skip to 5.1 when all are 2/9). Follow-ups 4.4 (who, Tarjeta E) and 4.5 (month) are not in the table. Tarjeta D itself is not in the questionnaire zip. Options: 1=Si, 2=No (print and catalogo); 9 set missing by the .do, no row. Both levels used by every item. Cross-check (route 9 style; .cache/mexico_2025_q3safety_violence/counts.py vs live_counts.R, server-side GROUP BY, no export): raw Q3 CSV 23642 rows (PER=0325 on every row, as batch_697 found), no blanks on any bp4_3 item; all 12 item x level counts identical raw vs live -- bp4_3_1 1/2 = 1126/22504, bp4_3_2 362/23269, bp4_3_3 381/23250, bp4_3_4 188/23442, bp4_3_5 290/23340, bp4_3_6 63/23568; raw code 9 = 12/11/11/12/12/11 (set missing); live 141783 rows = sum of the 12 cells, 0 missing resp, 0 duplicate id-item; 10 raw respondents have no 1/2 on any item, so live ids 23632 = 23642 - 10. Dictionary defects (Step 3b): Description 'Self-reported exposure to and experience with violent crime, Q3 2025' mislabels the block -- 4.3 asks about situations experienced WITH ONE OR MORE PEOPLE IN THE RESPONDENT'S HOUSEHOLD (family violence, per the .do's own bookmark and INEGI's section title), and two of the six (humiliation; being thrown out / threatened with it) are not violent crime; Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q3 wave (file suffix 0925) -- same defects as mexico_2024_q3safety_violence. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation). Reused verbatim from batch_684: CP3+CP4 instructions, situations 1 and 3-6, options Si/No. Translated fresh: the 4.3 stem ('from October 2024 to date') and situation 2, whose Spanish changed ('correrle'); the fresh English for situation 2 comes out identical to batch_684's ('Have you been thrown out of your home or threatened with being thrown out?') because the gender fill does not surface in English. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section IV question 4.3 from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, and added an English translation of its own; the items ask about situations the respondent experienced with members of their own household, not violent crime in general; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
